opportunities.title: Junior Scientist Conference Grants

amount.raw: Grants up to £200 (Scheme A), up to £500 (Scheme B), up to £750 (Adelphi co-sponsored), up to £300 (virtual conferences)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to Genetics Society members: undergraduates, master's and PhD students, and postdoctoral scientists within six years of PhD viva for Scheme A; PhD students and postdocs within six years for Schemes B & C. UK‑based members for non‑UK conferences and non‑UK members for UK conferences.
opportunities.summary: Supports attendance at genetics‑related conferences (in‑person or virtual) by covering travel, accommodation and registration costs.

opportunities.title: Training Grant
opportunities.eligibility_summary: All Genetics Society members studying or working in the UK, or attending a course held in the UK. Students must be members; other members need at least one year of membership.
opportunities.summary: Provides up to £1,200 to cover travel, accommodation, subsistence and registration for short training courses or collaborative visits to other laboratories.

opportunities.title: Heredity Fieldwork Grant
opportunities.eligibility_summary: All Genetics Society members studying or working in the UK, or intending to carry out fieldwork in the UK. Students need a supervisor letter; supervisor must be a member.
opportunities.summary: Supports field‑based genetic research projects by covering travel, accommodation, subsistence and consumables for fieldwork.

opportunities.title: Carer’s Award
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Any Genetics Society member, regardless of caring responsibilities or age of the person cared for.
opportunities.summary: Provides up to £60 per day to assist members with caring responsibilities to attend Society meetings or events.

opportunities.title: One‑off Meeting Grant

amount.raw: Sponsorship up to several thousand pounds; typical £1,000–£2,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to Genetics Society members; applications may be submitted any time, preferably at least three months before the event.
opportunities.summary: Provides financial sponsorship for genetics‑themed meetings not organised directly by the Society, covering venue, speaker fees and related costs.
